name: MoYu AoLong 3x3 V6 (Magnetic, MagLev, 20-Magnet Ball-Core, Nano Skin Feel)
description: The MoYu AoLong 3x3 V6 (Magnetic, MagLev, 20-Magnet Ball-Core, Nano Skin Feel) is the top-tier build of the AoLong V6 line, pairing a 100-magnet setup and a 20-magnet ball-core with MoYu's new nano skin-friendly surface for a soft, skin-like touch that holds up to long sessions.
features: Top of the AoLong V6 line: The full flagship build — 100 magnets, a 20-magnet ball-core, MagLev tension, and a carbon fiber core — in one package.
Full-range magnetic control: A flagship-level 100-magnet configuration delivers instant, precise positioning so turns settle in exactly where you want them.
MagLev elasticity: Springs are replaced by repelling magnets for silky-smooth tension adjustment free of internal resistance.
8-level tension: Balanced between loose and tight, pairing high corner-cutting with high precision for a stable, controllable solve.
Ball-Core Positioning 3.0: The 20-magnet ball-core with all-directional drive provides powerful centripetal force for greater speed and reduced resistance.
Carbon fiber core: A high-strength carbon fiber core is stronger, lighter, and more stable, keeping explosive turning anchored at the center.
